claims.title: Conflicting finality implies a slashed quorum intersection
claims.statement: In the abstract model, a finalization fork implies q_intersection_slashed: there exist two quorums whose shared validators are all slashable.

details: A finite validator type with decidable equality; a hash type with decidable equality; threshold, stake, validator-set, parent, genesis and state parameters.
The hypothesis finalization_fork contains two finalized blocks with mutual non-ancestry. Justification derivations encode the quorum links.
Transitive dependencies and axioms have not been completely audited by the atlas. The proof assistant, libraries and recorded model remain part of the trust boundary.

limitations: Structural result only: it does not assert that the shared set is nonempty or has positive weight.
Not a proof of Fulu state-transition conformance, deployed clients, signatures, network delivery or production accountable-safety thresholds.

claims.title: Post-genesis checkpoints stay unchanged or move strictly forward
claims.statement: A successful Lean model transition with a nonzero latest block-header slot leaves each justified/finalized checkpoint unchanged, including its root, or replaces it at a strictly greater slot.

details: The pre-state latestBlockHeader.slot is not zero; genesis anchoring is excluded.
Transitive dependencies and axioms have not been completely audited by the atlas. The proof assistant, libraries and recorded model remain part of the trust boundary.

limitations: Does not establish checkpoint ancestry across branches.
The Lean transition model is the subject, not the Python leanSpec implementation. The manual correspondence is not a refinement proof.

claims.title: Honestly generated KZG openings satisfy the pairing equation
claims.statement: For a coefficient vector, a generated power SRS and an evaluation point, KZG.correctness shows that the model's generated opening verifies for the polynomial's evaluation.

details: Prime p; prime-order groups G1, G2 and Gt with the module and equality structures in the theorem; the group order (Nat.card G1 = p) is carried by the PrimeOrderWith class instances, not an explicit theorem hypothesis after upstream #1468.
A bilinear pairing, generators, degree parameter n, SRS secret a, coefficient vector and evaluation point z, under the recorded Lean definitions.
Transitive dependencies and axioms have not been audited for this revision.

limitations: Algebraic correctness is not binding, knowledge soundness, ceremony security or zero knowledge.
Generic single-point coefficient-form opening, not Ethereum's batched cell verifier, blob encoding, BLS12-381 implementation or a deployed prover.

inheritance: Phase0 -> Altair -> Bellatrix -> Capella -> Deneb -> Electra -> Fulu; inherited definitions remain in force unless superseded.

Execution is independently pinned to Osaka; networking and solc have their own source identities.

architectureEdges.label: Data availability
architectureEdges.explanation: Fulu on_block requires is_data_available before accepting the block and its post-state.

architectureEdges.label: State transition
architectureEdges.explanation: on_block validates the block using the state transition before storing its post-state.

architectureEdges.label: Epoch processing
architectureEdges.explanation: Fulu process_epoch invokes inherited justification and finalization.

architectureEdges.label: Hash-tree roots
architectureEdges.explanation: State transition checks the block's state root using hash_tree_root.

architectureEdges.label: Signatures
architectureEdges.explanation: Signature validation and RANDAO processing call BLS verification.

architectureEdges.label: Block delivery
architectureEdges.explanation: Consensus block reception feeds on_block. An interface arrow points from the sender to the receiving role.

architectureEdges.label: SSZ-Snappy
architectureEdges.explanation: Consensus messages use SSZ-Snappy encoding.

architectureEdges.label: Cell proof checks
architectureEdges.explanation: Data column validation calls verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch.

architectureEdges.label: Data columns
architectureEdges.explanation: Gossip and Req/Resp deliver data-column sidecars to availability processing.

architectureEdges.label: Post-state
architectureEdges.explanation: Lstar on_block runs state_transition and advances its checkpoint store from the post-state.

architectureEdges.label: Checkpoint updates
architectureEdges.explanation: Attestation processing updates checkpoint values under strict slot guards.

architectureEdges.label: Hash-tree roots
architectureEdges.explanation: State and block-header processing use SSZ hash_tree_root.

architectureEdges.label: Block signatures
architectureEdges.explanation: Lstar on_block verifies signatures before the state transition.

architectureEdges.label: Public keys
architectureEdges.explanation: Signature verification reconstructs XMSS public keys and message bindings for the aggregate.

architectureEdges.label: Message roots
architectureEdges.explanation: SSZ roots of attestation data and blocks bind the aggregate proof to its messages.

architectureEdges.label: Tree hashing
architectureEdges.explanation: The XMSS Merkle tree uses PoseidonXmss to hash tree layers.

architectureEdges.label: Block delivery
architectureEdges.explanation: The sync service routes gossip blocks to head sync and calls the fork's on_block.

architectureEdges.label: SSZ-Snappy
architectureEdges.explanation: The pinned Lstar networking topics name SSZ-Snappy payload encoding.

architectureEdges.label: Execute transactions
architectureEdges.explanation: Osaka apply_body and process_transaction execute bytecode via the interpreter.

architectureEdges.label: State / receipt roots
architectureEdges.explanation: Block validation compares computed state, transaction and receipt roots.

architectureEdges.label: Chain synchronization
architectureEdges.explanation: ETH retrieves execution headers and bodies for execution; it does not choose consensus finality.

architectureEdges.label: EVM bytecode
architectureEdges.explanation: Compiler to target: solc emits bytecode during development. Execution does not invoke the compiler.
